text: Ɓen maayooɓe acca suddiiɓe ɓe ronndaaki, waɗɗike ɓen [suddiiɓe] habbagol ko'e maɓɓe lebbi nayi e balɗe sappo, ɓe heddoo ka cuuɗii, ɓe woɗɗitoo cuɗaari e desal. Si edda on timmii, bakkaatu fawaaki on (yo waliyuuɓe), e kon ko ɓe waɗaŋta ko'e maɓɓe -e hoore laawol shari'a; immorde e ɗin ɗi ɓe haɗanoo fewndo edda on. Alla No Anndi kon ko golloton, huunde e ko suuɗoton maa feeñinon wirnanaaki Mo. O Yoɓoyay on ɗum.
